data.description: Transcribe a meeting recording, produce a speaker-attributed summary, resolve participant names, and email the summary to all participants.
data.pseudocode:
BEGIN_CONTEXT
ConvertPCMToWAV(directoryPath)
transcripts = TranscribeMeeting(directoryPath)
summary = SummarizeMeetingBySpeaker(transcripts.full_meeting_transcript, transcripts.speaker_transcripts)
resolved = ResolveParticipants(summary, participants)
Email.Send(to: participants.emails, template: "meeting_summary", data: resolved)
Complete()
END_CONTEXT

END_MESSAGE

blueprint.title: Meeting Recording Transcription & Summary
blueprint.description: Converts per-participant PCM recordings to WAV, transcribes each one, produces a structured meeting summary attributed by speaker ID, resolves participant IDs to real names in that summary, and emails it to all participants.

Complete()
